resources.string: Uses installed offline voices. Preview pauses the source and restores its position and volume when stopped.
The 48 kHz guide keeps pitch while fitting at 0.6–1.6×. Estimated word times are not measured pronunciation boundaries.
Dense line. Consider splitting it or assigning two bars.
Sparse line. Try double time or half a bar.
Check the title and confirm each reading. Changed lyric text requires a newly confirmed reading.
I reviewed the density suggestions and choose these lengths
Place guide and lyric timing · one Undo
Placed in the song. Saving preserves the structure and guide for reopening.
No matching installed offline voice. Install a voice in the OS, then reopen and select it.
The lyrics or project changed. Close and reopen from the current lyrics.
This voice does not support the selected synthesis settings. Restore supported settings.
Cannot fit within 0.6–1.6×. Split the line, revise its reading, change its length, or regenerate. Speech is never truncated.
The voice returned silence. Check the reading or device voice and regenerate.
Generation and placement are unavailable during recording, arming, or another operation.
Cancelled. The project was not changed.
A line, duration, or storage limit was reached. Work in groups of up to 64 lines, at most 30 seconds each.
Processing or source restoration failed. Check the output, stop, and retry.
TTS guide preview · source controls return after Stop
Audio memory is full. Stop playback or close another audio task, then retry. No speech was truncated.
